policy: Preserve every formally approved amendment or administrative modification document. Check live TIP and STIP data monthly, but archive a complete generated snapshot only when the underlying data has changed. Retain quarterly snapshots and additional snapshots for major changes; do not retain redundant monthly exports whose data is unchanged or whose changes are trivial and already documented by a formal revision record.

change_detection.notes: An on-demand PDF export may have a new generated date without representing a newly approved revision. Describe it as a dated database snapshot unless the official source identifies a revision or approval action.

baseline_observation.result: The August 25 generated snapshot differed from the July snapshot by one added project, A302525, NM 304 Replacement of Bridge 3303, with $3,653,287 programmed in Valencia County; no projects were removed.
baseline_observation.revision_context: MRMPO Revision 79 was Approved with Exceptions and Revision 80 was Pending Public Comment, but the generated snapshot was not explicitly identified as Revision 79.
